title: अष्टाङ्गसंग्रह
summary: Vāgbhaṭa's Aṣṭāṅga Saṅgraha studied verse by verse: Sūtrasthāna chapters 1 to 5 and Kalpasthāna chapters 1 to 8, with Devanagari text, word split, Hindi and English, memory aids, pictures and six questions per unit.
source_disclaimer: पाठ: १८८८ का मराठी-मुद्रित संस्करण, खराब स्कैन से डिजिटाइज़ किया गया; कुछ पाठ अस्पष्ट या दूषित है। हिन्दी और English: AI-रचित, AI-समीक्षित; विद्वान् से जाँच शेष।

chapters.title: आयुष्कामीय
chapters.summary: Chapter 1, Āyuṣkāmīya: the invocation, the sages' request, the line of teaching from Brahmā, the aim of long life, and the plan of the whole work.

chapters.title: शिष्योपनयनीय
chapters.summary: Chapter 2, Śiṣyopanayanīya: the qualities of teacher and pupil, how the physician learns, and the four parts of treatment.

chapters.title: दिनचर्या
chapters.summary: Chapter 3, Dinacaryā: the daily routine and conduct from waking onward.

chapters.title: ऋतुचर्या
chapters.summary: Chapter 4, Ṛtucaryā: seasonal regimen, diet and conduct.

chapters.title: रोगानुत्पादनीय
chapters.summary: Chapter 5, Rogānutpādanīya: not letting disease arise, and the urges that should not be held back.

chapters.title: वमनकल्प
chapters.summary: Chapter 1, Vamanakalpa: the best emetic drugs with madana (emetic nut) foremost, collecting and storing madana fruit, madana in decoctions, powders, milk, curd, butter, electuaries, sweets and foods, emetic flowers and garlands, the emetic uses of jīmūtaka (bitter luffa), ikṣvāku (bitter bottle gourd), tumbī (bottle gourd) seed, dhāmārgava, kṛtavedhana and kuṭaja (kurchi) fruit, and devising further emetics on this pattern.

chapters.title: विरेचनकल्प
chapters.summary: Chapter 2, Virecanakalpa: the best purgative drugs, the two kinds of trivṛt (turpeth) and their collection, trivṛt by doṣa and in lehas, powders, pills, seasonal formulas, ghee, ariṣṭa and fermented drinks, the Kalyāṇaka guḍa, caturaṅgula (Indian laburnum) for the delicate, tilvaka and rodhra, snuhī (spurge) latex, śaṅkhinī and saptalā, dantī and dravantī, harītakī (chebulic myrobalan), and adjusting the strength of purgatives by combination and method.

chapters.title: वमनविरेचनव्यापत्सिद्धि
chapters.summary: Chapter 3, Vamanavirecanavyāpatsiddhi: emesis and purgation that fail or go the wrong way, medicine digested without effect, stiffened and stirred-up doṣas, distension (ādhmāna), cutting pain (parikartikā), oozing (parisrava), dysentery (pravāhikā), heart-seizure (hṛdayāpasaraṇa), seizing of the limbs by Vāta, excess (atiyoga) with flow of tissues, excess emesis with tongue and eye troubles, excess purgation with prolapse of the rectum, testing life-blood against raktapitta (jīvādāna), the causes of failed medicine, and the twelve complications with their remedies.

chapters.title: बस्तिकल्प
chapters.summary: Chapter 4, Bastikalpa: the all-curing balādi basti, meat-broth and daśamūla bastis, the eraṇḍa (castor) root nirūha, liquorice-milk bastis for burning, Kapha-removing and all-doṣa nirūhas, drug groups for cleansing, binding and scraping bastis, slimy (picchā) bastis and bastis for the complications of purification, bastis in jīvādāna, mild bastis measured in prasṛtas, making bastis sharper or milder, and rules for whom and how to give basti.

chapters.title: सिद्धबस्तिकल्प
chapters.summary: Chapter 5, Siddhabastikalpa: the named 'proven' enemas and their benefits, castor-root nirūha and yāpana enemas, yuktaratha and gomūtra enemas, the mustādi yāpana as king of yāpanas, milk enemas for children, the old and women, aphrodisiac enemas with egg fluids, crab and testes, the harms of excessive yāpana and restriction-free use, the sahacarādi unctuous enema, anuvāsana oils and ghees against Vāta, Pitta and Kapha, madana as the foremost fruit for āsthāpana, and how the enema works through the winds as the chief of all procedures.

chapters.title: बस्तिव्यापत्सिद्धिकल्प
chapters.summary: Chapter 6, Bastivyāpatsiddhikalpa: the twelve mishaps of enemas from non-application and over-application, obstruction, heaviness, distension and headache with their treatment, straining at stool, the enema rising to the mouth and nose and how to bring it down, colic and burning from over-application, limb pain, hiccup, heart injury and cutting pain, discharge of blood and Pitta, the thirty-six combined varieties and their complications, the tastes of the enema for each combination of doṣas, and ghee and gruels against diarrhoea.

chapters.title: स्नेहव्यापदिकासिद्धि
chapters.summary: Chapter 7, Snehavyāpadikāsiddhi: the seven mishaps of the unctuous enema, sneha covered by Vāta, Pitta, Kapha, over-eating and stool and their treatment, sneha rising to the throat, the faults of nozzles, enema bags, beds and the administering physician with their remedies, the diet of tastes after cleansing, the eight things to avoid such as loud speech, riding, walking, day-sleep and intercourse, and strengthening enemas for the always-ailing.

chapters.title: भेषजकल्प
chapters.summary: Chapter 8, Bheṣajakalpa: the kinds of land and the drugs they yield, the qualities of good drugs and the seasons for gathering each part, the rite of collecting and storing, animal products, the five preparations (expressed juice, paste, decoction, cold and hot infusion), dosage, the cooking of medicated ghee and oil with its signs of completion, the table of weights and measures with their synonyms, the three grades of sneha-cooking and their uses, and the Himavat and Vindhya medicines.
